description: MCP Market Intelligence Server: Expose Viper's market data services to MCP-compatible LLM clients (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, etc.) via a stdio-based FastMCP server. No API key required.
principles: No TUI dependency - viper/mcp/ imports only from viper/services/
Thin adapters - each tool is 10-30 lines wrapping existing services
stdio transport - required for Claude Code compatibility
Shared watchlist - MCP server reads/writes the same ~/.config/viper/watchlist.json
Error convention - return {error, symbol} dicts, no exceptions crossing MCP boundary
All tools return dict[str, object] - consistent, JSON-serializable

userStories.title: Historical Data + Technical Indicators Tools
acceptanceCriteria: get_price_history(symbol, period) returns OHLCV data with stats
Dates serialized to ISO 8601 strings
Stats include period_high, period_low, change_percent, avg_volume
get_technical_indicators(symbol, period, indicators, *_period) returns current values
Supports sma, ema, rsi, macd indicators
Returns only current (last) value for each indicator, not full arrays
Invalid indicator names return error dict
Custom periods supported for sma_period, ema_period, rsi_period
Test: OHLCV success with datetime serialization

userStories.notes: Indicators tool prevents massive responses by returning only current values.

technicalNotes.architecture: viper/mcp/ imports only viper/services/ - no Textual/Rich dependency
technicalNotes.transport: stdio JSON-RPC, required for Claude Code MCP protocol
technicalNotes.errorHandling: Services return error dataclasses, tools convert to {error, symbol} dicts
technicalNotes.indicatorDesign: Returns current (last non-None) value only to prevent massive LLM context
technicalNotes.watchlistSingleton: Lazy-initialized on first tool call, shares persistence with TUI

outOfScope: SSE or HTTP transport (stdio only for v1)
